user_story: As a guest, I want to filter bookings by status so that I can see only pending, confirmed, or cancelled reservations.

positive.title: Filter bookings to show only pending reservations
steps: Select 'Pending' from the status filter dropdown.
positive.expected_result: The bookings list is updated to show only reservations with a status of 'Pending'.

positive.title: Filter bookings to show only confirmed reservations
steps: Select 'Confirmed' from the status filter dropdown.
positive.expected_result: The bookings list is updated to show only reservations with a status of 'Confirmed'.

positive.title: Filter bookings to show only cancelled reservations
steps: Select 'Cancelled' from the status filter dropdown.
positive.expected_result: The bookings list is updated to show only reservations with a status of 'Cancelled'.

negative.title: Attempt to filter bookings with an invalid status option
steps: Manually enter an invalid status, such as 'In Progress', in the status filter field.
negative.expected_result: The system throws an error or shows a message stating 'Invalid status option'. No bookings list is updated or displayed.

negative.title: Apply filter without selecting any status
steps: Leave the status filter dropdown unselected.
negative.expected_result: The system should prompt the user to select at least one status or show all bookings by default.

edge.title: Filter bookings with a large number of reservations
steps: Select 'Pending' from the status filter dropdown.
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button in an environment with a large dataset (e.g., 10,000+ bookings).
edge.expected_result: The system efficiently filters and displays only 'Pending' bookings without performance degradation.

edge.title: Filter bookings with no reservations matching the selected status
steps: Select 'Cancelled' from the status filter dropdown in an environment where no bookings are cancelled.
edge.expected_result: The system displays a message indicating there are no bookings with the status 'Cancelled'.
